purpose: 在固定需求表达拒绝后，登记全自然机会/费用/保存叶解释，不提出新金融变体
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1'
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
r=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));assert r['status']=='REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_BANKERS_OVERALL_LOAN_DEMAND_CONDITION_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT'
period={x['era']:x for x in r['period_summaries']}
files=[out/n for n in ['result.json','每日贷款需求联合评分.csv','两模型全部自然高分机会.csv','保存贷款需求九变量模型.json','原八字段与贷款总体需求_原标签不变.parquet']]
files += [root/'data/reference/510300_dividends.csv',root/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json']
p={'study_id':'510300_BANKERS_LOAN_DEMAND_FIXED_FAILURE_SIGNAL_COST_SAVED_LEAF_DIAGNOSIS_V1','experiment_id':'E79','registered_at':now,
 'status':'REGISTERED_SAVED_ALL_OPPORTUNITIES_DIAGNOSIS_AFTER_E78_FIXED_REJECTION',
 'primary_candidate_events':period['2024—2025']['candidate_events'],'primary_control_events':period['2024—2025']['control_events'],
 'all_candidate_events':sum(z['candidate_events'] for z in r['period_summaries']),
 'question':'主期误差略降但自然净收益更差，先核全部机会的固定端点零费用算术界、原费用标签身份及保存叶/真实需求路径，不把账户风险约束未运行说成原因。',
 'fixed_cost_formula':'原10000股标签，买卖各10bp报价滑移，最小价格单位0.001，双边佣金4bp/最低5元，原登记日分红；标签复原，不新标签/账户。',
 'zero_fee_bound':'只同端点原始开盘和原登记日分红的解释界，不可交易账户，不改变原训练标签或费用门。',
 'saved_leaf':'主期全部自然高分叶及全部原成熟成员，float32比较同保存树阈值；包含正负极端及重叠5日标签，不删最大收益或重新估计树。',
 'new_models':0,'new_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_network_requests':0,'source_code_edits':0,'parents':[ident(x) for x in files],
 'old_rejection_preserved':True,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
dest=out/'固定失败归因协议.json';assert not dest.exists()
dest.write_text(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('E79全部30机会/主期10叶保存诊断已登记，新增拟合/标签/账户/网络0。')
